name: minimalist-f1-heiress-portrait
image_purpose: editorial campaign and motorsport profile visual

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic tight headshot of one original approved adult woman wearing a supplied safety-orange racing helmet in a high-key white studio.
prompt.main_subject: Original approved adult woman with light honey-blonde hair wisps escaping the helmet, sapphire-blue eyes, natural freckles, visible pores, realistic skin sheen and a neutral commanding expression. She wears the supplied glossy safety-orange racing helmet and a single strand of supplied South Sea pearls.
composition_elements: Centered straight-on eye-level 4:5 tight headshot with squared shoulders and direct gaze.
Overexposed seamless white studio void with crisp helmet edges and pearl necklace visible.
Preserve supplied helmet construction and emblem only from the attached product; do not invent branding.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Frontal large softbox with clinical high-key exposure, warm bounce on skin, soft shadows defining facial structure and precise product highlights.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4:5 headshot, Hasselblad H6D-400c MS with 85mm lens at f/5.6, pin-sharp irises and skin grain, subtle depth falloff, realistic helmet fiberglass and pearl texture, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Minimalist high-fashion motorsport headshot of one original approved adult woman staring directly into the lens with a commanding editorial presence. She has light honey-blonde wisps escaping from a supplied glossy safety-orange racing helmet, sapphire-blue eyes, natural freckles, visible pores, realistic skin sheen and a neutral relaxed mouth. Include a single strand of supplied South Sea pearls. Center her with squared shoulders in a straight-on 4:5 tight headshot against an overexposed seamless white studio void. Use a frontal large softbox, clinical high-key light, warm skin bounce, Hasselblad H6D-400c MS, 85mm lens at f/5.6, no text or watermark.

Preserve emblem only from the supplied helmet; do not invent text, logos or watermark.
